audit_entry_denial_reason_check.name: audit_entry_denial_reason_check
audit_entry_denial_reason_check.value: ("audit_entry"."action" <> 'transition_denied' or nullif(btrim("audit_entry"."denial_reason"), '') is not null) and ("audit_entry"."action" = 'transition_denied' or "audit_entry"."denial_reason" is null) and ("audit_entry"."action" not in ('transition_sent_back', 'line_item_flags_cleared', 'line_item_flags_clear_denied') or nullif(btrim("audit_entry"."outcome_reason"), '') is not null)

expense_report_hold_reason_check.name: expense_report_hold_reason_check
expense_report_hold_reason_check.value: ("expense_report"."on_hold" = true and nullif(btrim("expense_report"."hold_reason"), '') is not null) or ("expense_report"."on_hold" = false and "expense_report"."hold_reason" is null)

gl_coding_result_line_item_review_check.name: gl_coding_result_line_item_review_check
gl_coding_result_line_item_review_check.value: ("gl_coding_result"."line_item_review_action" is null and "gl_coding_result"."line_item_review_reason" is null and "gl_coding_result"."line_item_reviewed_by" is null and "gl_coding_result"."line_item_reviewed_at" is null) or ("gl_coding_result"."source_type" in ('line_item', 'mileage') and "gl_coding_result"."line_item_review_action" in ('approve', 'reject') and "gl_coding_result"."line_item_reviewed_by" is not null and "gl_coding_result"."line_item_reviewed_at" is not null and ("gl_coding_result"."line_item_review_action" <> 'reject' or nullif(btrim("gl_coding_result"."line_item_review_reason"), '') is not null))

stage_transition_valid_edge_check.name: stage_transition_valid_edge_check
stage_transition_valid_edge_check.value:
(
                ("stage_transition"."from_stage" = 'Drafted' and "stage_transition"."to_stage" = 'Drafted' and "stage_transition"."reason" = 'report_created')
                or ("stage_transition"."from_stage" = 'Drafted' and "stage_transition"."to_stage" = 'Submitted')
                or ("stage_transition"."from_stage" = 'Submitted' and "stage_transition"."to_stage" = 'Manager Approval')
                or ("stage_transition"."from_stage" = 'Manager Approval' and "stage_transition"."to_stage" = 'AP Review')
                or ("stage_transition"."from_stage" = 'AP Review' and "stage_transition"."to_stage" = 'Paid')
                or ("stage_transition"."from_stage" = 'Paid' and "stage_transition"."to_stage" = 'Reconciled')
                or ("stage_transition"."from_stage" = 'Manager Approval' and "stage_transition"."to_stage" = 'Drafted')
                or ("stage_transition"."from_stage" = 'AP Review' and "stage_transition"."to_stage" = 'Drafted')
                or ("stage_transition"."from_stage" = "stage_transition"."to_stage" and "stage_transition"."reason" like 'transition_denied:%')
            )
